_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution: a mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so `s.stdio.semio.document`'s oracle registration and catalog live here rather than in a shared manifest. `s.stdio.semio.document` is a semio-NATIVE format, so its reference is a second IMPLEMENTATION written in another language from the committed grammars and the committed binary protocol rather than a third-party package.

oracles.rationale: No third-party library in any ecosystem reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` envelope, so the second producer THE STANDARD requires is a second IMPLEMENTATION in another language. `../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-semio-document/🐍️component.py` is that implementation: the text and binary semio envelopes, the whole `document = artifact-mark schema-line styles-line images-line blocks-line` grammar in both directions - `style`, `image`, `run`, `run-style`, `option-hex`, `option-f64` and the eight single-letter-tagged `block` variants P/H/L/T/C/Q/I/B with their recursive list, table and quote nesting included - the binary pack frame in both directions, and all eighteen verbs of this subset's vocabulary together with their inverses. It is written from this subset's own committed snapshot grammar, binary protocol and mutations grammar, from the committed TypeScript schema mirror for the three `DocBlockPath` segment tags (`quote`, `listItem`, `tableCell`), and from the envelope section of the framework carrier module, importing nothing from and transliterating nothing of the Rust it judges. The snapshot grammar states the one thing a reader would otherwise get wrong and the Python follows it: `enc_f64` prints `f64::to_bits()` as plain decimal digits, not a float literal, so every `f64` leaf is a bare INT token. One boundary is recorded rather than smoothed over: the binary protocol document declares `styles`/`images`/`blocks` one opaque trailing `payload` chain by its own admission, so that layer was DERIVED from the committed pack example's bytes - LEB128 varint counts, length-prefixed UTF-8 strings, little-endian `f64` leaves, a `u8` bool, a `u8` option discriminant and a per-variant `u8` block tag in the grammar's own variant order - and the derivation is pinned by byte-exact re-encoding of that committed file, which a misreading could not produce. `package` is deliberately the empty string: the implementation needs no distribution, so it contributes nothing to the dependency ledger and nothing to the import-purity probe. The CommonMark route was surveyed again and still rejected on the merits rather than for absence - the oracle role may never link the subject crate, so `comrak` 0.54 could only be handed a document this repository's own Markdown exporter produced, and CommonMark carries no named style table, no id-keyed embedded image store and no run-level character formatting that survives a parse-render cycle, stranding ten of the eighteen kinds.
